title: Vlog #9832 (2025-12-12) is a genuine mental-health disclosure, not just vlog content

owner_note.text: While annotating this stream for the video-editor pipeline, I read a transcript where you plainly and repeatedly describe daily suicidal ideation for years, and say you'd end your life instantly if not for your kids — stated flat, not as a dramatic bit. I flagged those spans `sensitive` in the data so no auto-clip tool ever surfaces them as funny/short-clip material, but I'm also saying it here directly: if that's still how you feel, it's worth talking to someone today — 988 (US Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, call or text) or a therapist, not just the one you mentioned seeing Monday if that's stalled. This is a flag, not a task; nothing for you to do about the pipeline.
